title: What if you swallowed a rubber duck?

scenes.text: What happens if you accidentally swallow a rubber duck?
First, it slides down your throat, squeaking the entire way down.
Then it lands in your stomach, a pool of acid strong enough to eat through a razor blade.
But rubber ducks float. So it just... bobs there.
Your stomach squeezes to crush it.
So for the next three days, every time you hiccup... you squeak.
